text:
tom: Quick thread to lock observability MVP scope after today's sync. Need a short, testable list we can ship to staging.

priya: TL;DR: focus on lightweight visibility (cost + latency + error classes) and a tiny trace path for request->routing->model exec. No heavy retention or ML-based RCA for MVP.

carlos: From infra: We can add 1% trace sampling default and an org-level toggle to jump to 100% for up to 24h. That requires PII scrub pass before persisting.

emily: UX ask: include a small per-route table (last 7d) with columns: requests, avg tokens, est cost, p95 latency, error%. Click row -> expand to model breakdown. No complex drilldowns in MVP.

sam: Ops ask: define emergency fallback. Suggest: if model p99 > 2x target OR error rate > 5% for 10m -> automatic reroute to fallback model pool and page oncall. Agree?

tom: Yes on fallback. Also: add a lightweight "why-cost" modal showing top factors (model time, cache misses, embeddings). Not full per-token attribution, just a heuristic breakdown.

priya: Instrumentation checklist (short):
- trace spans: http_recv -> routing_decision -> queue_wait -> kv_cache_hit/miss -> model_infer -> response_serialize
- trace ids propagated as `X-RW-TRACE` header
- sampling: default 1%, org-toggle for 100% capture
- logs: annotate requests with model_id, token_count header for cost estimation

carlos: Note: adding `X-RW-TRACE` header is trivial, but make sure proxies don't drop it. We'll add in proxy-config.

emily: Dashboard acceptance criteria (concrete):
- per-route table shows 7d metrics, loads <2.5s on first open for 95% of users
- model-breakdown panel shows top 5 models by cost with sparkline
- error-class panel buckets by 5xx, timeout, parse-error, and model-hallucination (heuristic tag)

sam: Monitoring acceptance:
- alert when p99 > 1.5x SLO for 5m
- alert when error rate > 3x baseline for 10m
- alert routes to oncall + slack #eng-oncall channel with link to disposable dashboard

priya: Privacy/retention: default trace retention 30d. Enterprise can request 90d but that is post-MVP and maps to pricing.

tom: Timeline + rough scope: lock today -> 2 sprints to alpha internal -> 4 sprints to beta with customers. MVP feature list minimal: dashboards + trace link + cost-summary + rollout fallback + runbook.

emily: Engineering estimate: ~2.5 engineer-weeks (1 backend infra to handle traces + headers, 1 frontend to build table + panels, 0.5 for runbook and alerts).

carlos: Risk callouts:
- query explosion: need rate limits on dashboard queries. Propose default per-org query QPS cap and cached top queries for 5m.
- ingest cost: keep rollups off by default; only compute aggregates on demand for now.

sam: Runbook snippet (to include in repo):
1) Verify ingestion pipeline health (`/infra/observability/health`)
2) If traces failing -> flip `observability.traces.disabled` -> fallback to logs-only and page infra
3) If dashboard slow -> enable cached mode and open mitigation ticket

priya: Customer communication: CS wants a short "MVP coverage" page listing what customers get and what's missing (e.g., no per-token billing, no 90d retention, no automated RCA). Emily, can you draft?
emily: Yup will draft and include sample queries + workaround (export CSV of raw logs for token-level billing).

tom: Final checks before lock: @priya confirm span list + header, @carlos confirm retention and proxy changes, @sam confirm alerts and fallback, @emily confirm CS note. Reply by EOD PST.

priya: Confirmed spans + header + org-toggle flow.
carlos: Confirmed proxy change and 30d retention default.
sam: Confirmed alert thresholds and fallback flow. Pager on-call included.
emily: I'll post CS note draft in #customer-success by 16:00 PST.

alert-bot: NOTE: feature-branch `obs/mvp-scope-lock` created. CI queued.

tom: Thanks all. Locking scope at 17:30 PST unless objections. Minor follow-ups can be PRs. :white_check_mark:
